QiboTN

Accelerate Bench task · Quantum circuits

QiboTN simulates parameterized quantum circuits and computes observables.

Task version3.3.0CPU budget8 CPUsMemory32 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

Each input specifies an entangling circuit whose full state and observables are computed on the CPU.

Correctness

An independent state-vector simulation supplies the reference for amplitudes, normalization, single-qubit expectations, selected probabilities and the tensor-network observable.

Timing

Each circuit runs in a fresh Python process. Timing includes interpreter startup, imports and the complete workflow.

Reported runtime-saving reward

First-run rewards on benchmark v1.1, from the data behind paper Table 1, rounded to one decimal. Failed correctness is distinct from a correct result with zero speedup reward.
